Name: Stardew Caffeine Expanded
Author: imperialsympathizer
Description:
[size=6]Welcome to Stardew Caffeine Expanded![/size]

This is a mod that I primarily started for myself as I was frustrated at the fact that there was very little reason to use Green Tea over Triple Shot Espresso in-game, despite preferring teas in real life. After initial rebalance work, I decided to expand even further upon the game's foundation of drinks and provide drink options that could cover every buff type available to the player in vanilla SV.

[size=5][b]What the mod is:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Adds new processing/cooking recipes for tea and coffee that are more immersive than just "coffee or tea leaves in a keg"
[*]A slight drink rebalance to make coffee, teas, and other drinks interesting for consideration depending on preference and need
[*]Provides an additional gameplay use for fruit tree products
[/list]
﻿[b][size=5]What the mod is NOT:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]An expansion of non-caffeinated beverages (including juice, alcohol, etc.)
[*]An exhaustive catalog of every coffee and tea drink that exists
[*]A hyper-realism mod with specialized machines for every process related to tea and coffee
[/list]
[size=5][b]Compatibility
[/b][/size]
The only compatibility issues that could arise are mods that override the same data as this one. So any mods that update the duration or buffs of drinks like Green Tea, Coffee, Triple Shot Espresso, or Ginger Ale [b]might[/b] have non-game breaking conflicts with this one. Those would be simple data patch conflicts though, which should never break the game (though you might not see the correct buffs/durations for certain items).

Additionally, any mods that add the ability to place Tea Leaves in a Dehydrator, or Tea Leaves/Coffee Beans in a Mill [b]might[/b] have a conflict. I'm not sure how the game resolves what item gets created if there are  two potential "recipes" for output from a machine, so there might be a risk of weird issues in those cases.

Other than that, there should be no compatibility risks with any other mods, but as always, make sure to back up your save file first before you try it out!

Compatible with mods such as:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22376]Uncle Iroh Tea
[/url]﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]

[size=5][b]New Items Added
[/b][/size][size=4][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/23794/23794-1715263764-988582586.png[/img]
Crafting/Inedible Items:
[/size][list=1]
[*]Ice (purchased from Sandy's Oasis shop for 30g)
[*]Dried Tea Leaves (created from vanilla Tea Leaves in the Dehydrator)
[*]Coffee Grounds (created from vanilla Coffee Beans in the Mill)
[*]Matcha Powder (created from vanilla Tea Leaves in the Mill)
[*]Apricot Teabag (Dried Tea Leaves + Apricot in the player kitchen)
[*]Mango Teabag (Dried Tea Leaves + Mango in the player kitchen)
[*]Orange Teabag (Dried Tea Leaves + Orange in the player kitchen)
[*]Peach Teabag (Dried Tea Leaves + Peach in the player kitchen)
[*]Pomegranate Teabag (Dried Tea Leaves + Pomegranate in the player kitchen)

[/list]
[size=4]Drink Items:
[/size][list=1]
[*]Single Shot Espresso (Coffee Grounds in a keg)
[*]Cappuccino (Single Shot Espresso + Milk in the player kitchen)
[*]Cold Brew (Coffee Grounds + Ice in the player kitchen)
[*]Sweet Cream Cold Brew (Cold Brew + Sugar + Milk in the player kitchen)
[*]Matcha Tea (Matcha Powder in a keg)
[*]Matcha Latte (Matcha Tea + Milk in the player kitchen)
[*]Iced Matcha Latte (Matcha Latte + Ice + Sugar in the player kitchen)
[*]Apricot-Infused Tea (Apricot Teabag in a keg)
[*]Mango-Infused Tea (Mango Teabag in a keg)
[*]Orange-Infused Tea (Orange Teabag in a keg)
[*]Peach-Infused Tea (Peach Teabag in a keg)
[*]Pomegranate-Infused Tea (Pomegranate Teabag in a keg)
[/list]
[u][color=#00ff00]All recipes for these new items can be found at the Saloon!
[/color][/u]

[size=5][b]Drink Categories By Player Buff[/b]
[/size]
[list=1]
[*]Basic caffeine products [2 minutes, +1 Speed]: [b]Coffee, Green Tea[/b]
[*]Milk caffeine products [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +50 Energy/+23 Health]: [b]Cappuccino, Matcha Latte[/b]
[*]Iced caffeine products [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +1 tile magnetism]: [b]Cold Brew, Iced Tea[/b]
[*]Fruit tea products [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +2 Farming/Fishing/Foraging/Mining OR +1 Luck]: [b]Apricot, Mango, Orange, Peach, and Pomegranate-Infused Teas[/b]
[*]Attack buff product [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +3 Attack]: [b]Triple Shot Espresso[/b]
[*]Defense buff product [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +3 Defense]: [b]Matcha Tea[/b]
[*]Artisan/high value products [5 minutes, +1 Speed, +125 Energy/+56 Health, 800g sell price, universal love*]: [b]Sweet Cream Cold Brew, Iced Matcha Latte[/b]
[/list]
*certain NPCs like Jas and Vincent will still dislike or hate these items


[size=5][b]Vanilla Drink Changes
[/b][/size]
[size=4]Coffee[/size]
[list]
[*]Still crafted as normal by placing Coffee Beans in a keg
[*]No longer crafts into Triple Shot Espresso
[*]buff duration changed to 2 minutes
[/list]
[size=4]Green Tea[/size]
[list]
[*]Still crafted as normal by placing Tea Leaves in a keg
[*]Provides a +1 speed boost and no longer affects Max Energy, which is a relatively useless buff
[*]buff duration changed to 2 minutes
[/list]
[size=4]Triple Shot Espresso[/size]
[list]
[*][b]Crafting recipe changed [/b]to 3 Single Shot Espresso
[*]buff duration changed to 5 minutes
[*]Provides a +3 player Attack buff in addition to the normal +1 speed buff (stacks with food buffs)
[/list]
[size=4]Ginger Ale[/size]
[list]
[*]Provides a +2 Luck buff to still be a viable option compared to Mango-Infused Tea
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation
[/b][/size]
Make sure you have all required mods installed first!

Unzip the file, then copy the folder to your steamapps/common/Stardew Valley/Mods directory.

That's it!

To uninstall, simply delete the Stardew Caffeine Expanded folder from your .../Mods directory.
